title: No cross-level fallback
text: There is no exhausted-pool cross-level fallback. Cursor Opus medium is SENIOR and cannot escape JUNIOR exhaustion. No usable selection refuses level_no_capacity with each candidate reason and recovery; capacity-stopped workers use same-level recovery excluding the refused model. Provider-capacity stops use the normal 60/300/900-second wake backoff before same-level successor placement; message wording never bypasses the wake budget.
